'''2007 New York State Championship Kirk England LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kirk England]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Kirk
* '''Deck name:''' OMG, I Can't believe it's not Combat
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
